statement: For the inverse-weight Lin--Lu--Yau curvature and normalized flow on C3 fixed in source.md and problem.md, the curvature vector is given exactly by equations (4) and (5) of evidence/curvature_fixed_points.md in the four shortest-path chambers, with componentwise wall agreement. The complete positive normalized fixed-point set is the uniform point together with all permutations of (r,1,1)/(r+2) for r >= 2. In particular, (2/3,1/6,1/6) is a strict-chamber fixed point with singleton omega-limit set and disproves universal convergence to the uniform metric. No claim is made here about omega limits of non-fixed initial data.
contribution: Exact all-chamber primal/dual curvature certificates, a complete classification of interior fixed points, and an exact positive counterexample to the source's universal uniform-convergence subclaim; the global phase portrait remains open.
